rules.accepted_credit_types: AMA Category 1; AOA Category 1A; AAPA Category 1
rules.audit_note: Licensee keeps CME records and presents proof if audited by the Board; inactive licensees are not subject to CME.
rules.notes: Biennium Feb 1 - Jan 31 (renewal by Jan 31 of even years). Board notice (Act 181, SLH 2019): NCCPA certification no longer required at renewal, CME instead; the PA renewal page still asks for proof of current NCCPA certification with hardcopy renewals.
